parameters_used.coordinate_system: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; q1 yaw about +Z, q2/q3 about local -Y; zero links down

mass.coordinate_origin: Body hip yaw mount plane. Body bottom is z=-0.035m. All following COM positions use that frame.
mass.provenance: The per-link CAD inertials are authoritative for this simulation. Older scalar component allowances remain only for compatibility and must not be summed as the new robot mass.

servo.model: Feetech STS3215 C018 12V assumed correct ordered variant
servo.provenance: Electrical endpoints from C018 datasheet research; linear voltage/torque-speed scaling, current approximation, delay, bandwidth, deadband, backlash, continuous/peak derating are unmeasured assumptions.

transmission.motor_coordinate_equation: s=[2*yaw,2*hip,2*knee]; normalized actuator directions, physical commissioning pending
transmission.provenance: Design assumptions pending packaging and loaded reversal/deflection/efficiency measurement; motor travel is usable span around calibrated neutral, not absolute zero.

wheel_motor.provenance: Manufacturer reference, not selected purchase: GBP25.61 motor plus driver exceeds requested circa GBP15. Current cap is an unvalidated engineering assumption, not a published continuous rating.

environment.provenance: All assumed; stair geometry, floor grip, tire behavior and stair noses need measurement. No human or hardware measurements made.

simulation.provenance: Explicit controller and numerical assumptions, not identified STS firmware.

cad_evidence.collision_geometry_in_urdf: Simplified primitive links, not final CAD meshes
material_mass_assumptions: Purchased-part nominal mass is distributed uniformly over its simplified envelope.
Printed mass uses solid material volume, including free-state pad volume; no infill reduction.
Compressed pads retain their free-state mass in the assembled shape distribution.
Electronics 250 g, harness 150 g and extras 50 g are each added once to base_link.
Internal transmission rotors remain lumped into their declared simulation link.
cad_evidence.internal_rotors: Mass and pose inertia included in housing links; independent rotor kinetic energy omitted

limitations: Ideal external vertical force on one suspended wheel, body fixed. This is a loading fixture surrogate, not a gait or measured servo test. Uses the same command-play and compliance approximations as run_sim.py.
